# Environment

```{r environment, echo=T, message=FALSE, include=T, results=T}
#Packages
packages <- c("tidyverse",'kableExtra') 

#Load Packages
invisible(lapply(packages,library,character.only=T,quietly=T))

# Source library
source("./lib/consistent_themes.R")

# Print environment

Sys.info()
sessionInfo()
```

# Load data
```{r}
comparison_of_any_ESCRE_to_WGS_outcomes <- readRDS("./data/diagnostic_statistics/species_level_diagnostic_statistics.RDS")
```

# Edit column names
```{r}
stable3 <- comparison_of_any_ESCRE_to_WGS_outcomes %>% select(outcome_rename,tp,fp,tn,fn,sens,spec,ppv,npv,false_persistence_rate,overall_disagreement) 

colnames(stable3) <- recode(colnames(stable3),
                            'outcome_rename' = 'Criteria',
                            "tp" = "True positive (TP)",
                            "fp" = "False positive (FP)",
                            "tn" = "True negative (TN)",
                            "fn" = "False negative (FN)",
                            "sens" = "Sensitivity",
                            'spec' = "Specificity",
                            "ppv" = 'Positive predictive value (PPV)',
                            'npv'='Negative predictive value (NPV)',
                            'false_persistence_rate' = "False persistence rate (1-PPV)",
                            "overall_disagreement" = "Overall disagreement (1-accuracy)")
stable3 %>% favorite_kable()
```

# Save table as CSV and RDS file
```{r}
saveRDS(stable3,"./tables/s_table_3_species_level_diagnostic_statistics.RDS")
write_csv(stable3,"./tables/s_table_3_species_level_diagnostic_statistics.csv")
```
